summary: Make external-grant profile admission and append one owned critical section

replay.detail: Existing grant claims retain their meanings; no migration or replay change.

rules.detail: The existing cross-profile admission rule is now atomic across independent grant subjects. Multiple same-profile grants remain allowed; service issuance stays disabled.

compatibility.detail: Existing lifecycle and approval-once TRANSITIONS critical sections remain unchanged. Admission uses an inner synchronous lock and never awaits or acquires the outer lifecycle lock.

recovery.detail: Existing expiry and append-only revocation remain unchanged; no recovery action required.
